claims.claim: Under zero context (None), GPT-6 Astra achieves 0% success (0/3) across all evaluated tasks.
Supplying human video demonstration improves towel and notebook pickup success from 0/3 to 2/3.
Supplying Robot Video + Action achieves 100% (3/3) success on bimanual bottle cap unscrewing.
On red towel pickup, human video context enables GPT-6 Astra to achieve 100% progress while reducing run time from 24.63 to 15.85 min and token usage from 12.047M to 4.956M.
Fable 5.1 and Kimi K3 fail to pick the towel, reaching only 30% and 20% progress.
Numerical action references reduce target-to-demonstration gripper orientation error from 0.42 to 0.12 rad.
